# Standard of Care Upon agreeing to provide medical care, staff assume the following duties of care:
- They must provide a reasonable level of skillful, quality care - They must not make critical errors resulting in major personal injury or death, at the risk of criminal and civil charges. - They must show diligence in providing treatment, both inside and outside of the medical department area during their shift. - They must provide privacy to patients in non-emergency situations. - If they have limited resources, they must allocate what resources are available to them via triage. - They must not provide treatment that would breach Space Law or violate ethical principles. - They must ensure that implant removals or searches are performed by trained medical personnel and properly given authorization via a valid search warrant. The need for a warrant is removed during a Code Gamma or similar alert status.
